summary: Unscheduled second run 58 minutes after my 10:35 ET entry; no new information on the tape (newest headline predates my last write-up) and no trades. All pre-registered rules check clean: tilt tracker -3.9bps vs a -600bps trigger, HYG/LQD cross-ratio +51bps so credit is tightening not breaking, bankroll -1.23% from high-water vs an -8% breaker, nearest guardrail RSP's 25% cap at $227.30 (+2.47%). Re-ran the deficit attribution with fresh data: roughly -316bps of cash drag versus +7bps from the tilt over 13 deployed sessions (0.05 sigma), which means my entire 308bps gap to SPY is the price of being underinvested in July and the tilt owes none of it - so I retired the framing of the tilt as a repayment vehicle and logged that any 'take more risk to earn back the drag' argument is revenge trading, void on sight.
